symptom: On a native page, describe → exec turned `'Color': 'Brand primary'` from Forms$OptionDesignPropertyValue (Option) into Forms$CustomDesignPropertyValue (Value); `Size` on the same widget stayed an option. mx check 0 errors either way. check -p warned MDL-WIDGET12 that the native values 'Brand primary' and 'Smallest' were not allowed
cause: loadThemeRegistry read only themesource/*/web/design-properties.json, so every widget was typed against the web definitions. Atlas Core 4.1.3 declares DynamicText Color as a web ColorPicker (swatch 'Brand Primary') and a native Dropdown (option 'Brand primary'); a value off the web list on a ColorPicker resolves to custom
file: mdl/executor/theme_reader.go (NativeWidgetProperties, ForPlatform); cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (buildPageV3: layoutIsNative); cmd_pages_layout_v3.go; cmd_pages_create_v3.go (storedSnippetIsNative); design_property_routing.go (documentTheme, used by alter page, alter pages styling, alter styling, the snippet-call check); mdl/backend/pagemutator/probe.go (DocumentPlatform); validate_design_properties.go (validateDesignProperties, nativeLayoutResolver)
fix: Load the native design-properties.json files beside the web ones and select by the document's platform: a page by its layout's Native flag (FormCall.Form for a stored page), a layout by its layout type, a snippet by its stored Type. check -p resolves the layout from the script or the project
insight: When one property changes kind and its siblings do not, diff the two platforms' theme files for that key before reading writer code: `jq '.DynamicText[] | select(.name=="Color")'` on web/ and native/ showed ColorPicker vs Dropdown and a one-letter case difference in the option, which is the whole bug. The value's spelling matching the native option exactly, and missing the web one by case, is what made it custom. mx check does not flag a custom value on a native Dropdown, so the write layer is the only place to test it; the full run needs a BSON edit to put Studio Pro's Option shape back first, because mxcli had written Custom at create time
